title: Pro Shop Store Credit: top-up amount and bonus-rate basis by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's standing top-up amount and bonus-crediting rate basis, across every tier the product offers: the standard top-up amount, the smallest top-up accepted, the ceiling on the stored balance, the ordinary bonus-credit rate, the seasonal promotional bonus rate, and the number of months the ordinary bonus rate is locked against a rate change.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Standard top-up amount | Smallest top-up accepted | Ceiling on stored balance | Ordinary bonus-credit rate | Seasonal promotional bonus rate | Bonus-rate lock period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 50.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 200.00 USD | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 months |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 100.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 2 percent | 2 percent | 0 months |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 250.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 750.00 USD | 5 percent | 5 percent | 12 months |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 500.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 1500.00 USD | 8 percent | 8 percent | 24 months |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 100.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 3 percent | 3 percent | 0 months |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 250.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 750.00 USD | 6 percent | 6 percent | 12 months |

## Points of reference
- The standard top-up amount is the deposit size a member ordinarily adds in one transaction for that tier; a member may still choose to add a different amount, subject to the smallest-accepted floor shown above.
- The ceiling on the stored balance is the highest total the account may ever hold for that tier, regardless of how the balance was built up.
- Where a tier shows equal ordinary and seasonal rates, no promotional lift is currently available for that tier; where the seasonal rate exceeds the ordinary rate, a promotional period grants the higher figure instead of the ordinary one.
- The bonus-rate lock period states how many months the ordinary bonus-credit rate shown above is held steady against a rate change once a member opens that tier; a tier showing 0 months carries no such lock.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tier's smallest accepted top-up is the highest?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier, at 100.00 USD.
**Does every tier accept the same ceiling on stored balance?** No — the ceiling scales with the tier, from 200.00 USD on the Starter Credit $50 Tier up to 1500.00 USD on the VIP Credit $500 Tier.
